description:
The agent rules do not say what borrow-checker appeasement is, so a builder has no name for the pattern and no loop for removing it.

Change:
- .agent/strategies/ownership-shape.md: what appeasement is, five minimal before/after examples (clone to iterate, owned return from a reader, collect to release a borrow, placeholder swap, hand-placed drop), what is not appeasement, the loop (signature first, sort the errors, three moves in order of preference, stop rule) and its gates.
- .agent/strategies.md: index entry with its trigger.
- .agent/rules.md (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md): one Best Practices line defining the term and pointing at the strategy.

Documentation only; no code changes.
title: The rules name borrow-checker appeasement and the strategy that removes it
